title: EC-Council ECES
summary: EC-Council ECES is a professional certification offered by EC-Council. This independent study guide covers all 6 course modules: Introduction and History of Cryptography, Symmetric Cryptography & Hashes, Number Theory and Asymmetric Cryptography, Applications of Cryptography, Cryptanalysis, Quantum Computing and Cryptography. Every module has a MEDIUM and a HARD scenario exam, written as realistic workplace situations rather than recall questions, so you practise applying each module the way the job asks for it.
attributionNote: EC-Council certification content is an independent study guide written for CyberPulseAcademy and is not affiliated with or endorsed by EC-Council.
